FIELDS.NAME: Spotless Solutions Cleaning Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Spotless Solutions Cleaning Services, our core operations focus on delivering high-quality janitorial and cleaning services tailored to commercial spaces, including offices, retail environments, and educational institutions. We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean and safe working environment for our clients by employing trained staff who follow strict protocols for the safe handling and storage of cleaning chemicals. Our employees undergo comprehensive training in chemical safety and are subject to background checks to ensure reliability and trustworthiness, mitigating risks of dishonesty. We operate during standard business hours and utilize company vehicles for the transport of cleaning personnel and equipment, always adhering to safety regulations and conducting regular vehicle maintenance. Our commitment to compliance extends to maintaining recent documentation of our risk management practices, ensuring that we remain transparent and responsible in all our operations. By continuously assessing our practices and updating protocols, we strive to uphold the highest standards of cleanliness and safety while minimizing any potential environmental impacts.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 06/15/2023; Cause: Equipment damage due to accidental spillage during cleaning; Amount: $1,500; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial Safe, Class B, Fire Resistant, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour security monitoring and access controlled entry system.
